import openpyxl

def get_green_cells(file_path):
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path, data_only=True)
    ws = wb.active
    greens = []
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            fill = cell.fill
            if fill and fill.patternType == 'solid':
                color = (fill.start_color.rgb or fill.fgColor.rgb)
                if color in ['FF00FF00', 'FF008000', 'FF00FF99', 'FF00CC00']:
                    greens.append((cell.row, cell.column))
    print(greens)
